evidence_quotes.agenda: 'I just like to know first if you have any concern about the process or let's say, do you have any worries that you'd like to talk about?' — asked before any logistics probing. Full credit.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said no initial concern, but a real access-safety concern (spiral staircase) emerged during logistics; rep followed it two layers deep — asked for a photo, expressed her own genuine concern about mover safety/access, then proactively checked Zillow to verify before pricing. Scored on the merits as full follow-up, not the exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move only takes about four hours, five hours, then you will only be charged for that' present; missing rate/experience, self-prep tip, fair-check.

top_strength: Proactive diligence on a real safety/access concern (checked Zillow independently to verify the staircase type before finalizing the estimate) — genuine care beyond the script.
coaching_note: Add the four differentiators — the discovery and follow-up were excellent, but no damage coverage, meet-your-mover, on-time, or communication content appeared.
